recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-10529 itself; handle SpecimenDefinition relationship prose and Catalog-resource cleanup only through FHIR-54837 or another final work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-10529 asked O&O to introduce SpecimenDefinition as a new resource, derived from specimen requirement content without instance-only Specimen fields such as status and subject, so eDOS/laboratory catalog orderables could express specimen collection requirements and be used by ActivityDefinition.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-10529. The apparent source application is commit 8cb3819831ae04dbab4d6ce22eb9f73b736e4090, which added SpecimenDefinition source files and fhir.ini registrations in 2017 as part of the Catalog/SOA work. The ActivityDefinition side was applied separately by FHIR-10528 in commit c890d2deb85cbdbc98047ae7f8e9b57cd09186c0.
additional_context: FHIR-10528, the paired ActivityDefinition issue, is already represented on the combined branch by commit 014ec9a136f256360612a0de2e6af75964be2f64. Later Published issue FHIR-32751 explains why current ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement is canonical rather than the original Reference wording. FHIR-20553 withdrew a proposed backbone-element reshaping. FHIR-54837 is a later Triaged narrative-cleanup issue for SpecimenDefinition relationships, including the stale Catalog-resource bullet, and is not final enough to edit in this default Applied/Published reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/fhir.ini includes both ActivityDefinition and SpecimenDefinition as active resources, source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml defines the requested resource, and source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml defines specimenRequirement as a repeating canonical to SpecimenDefinition.

related_jiras.note: The ActivityDefinition specimenRequirement side of the same lab catalog change; already reconciled on the combined branch.
Changed ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement and related elements from Reference to canonical.
Rejected/withdrew a later request to make ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement a backbone element.
Later Triaged issue proposes SpecimenDefinition relationship narrative cleanup, so it was not applied here.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive O&O issue requesting a new SpecimenDefinition resource for eDOS/laboratory catalog specimen collection requirements, to be used by ActivityDefinition.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed intent: create a SpecimenDefinition resource and support the ActivityDefinition laboratory catalog use case.

evidence_items.summary: Added SpecimenDefinition source files and fhir.ini registrations as part of the 2017 Catalog/SOA work.
evidence_items.learned: This is the apparent initial source application of the seed request even though the commit did not name FHIR-10529.

evidence_items.summary: ActivityDefinition and SpecimenDefinition are active current-build resources, and SpecimenDefinition has abbreviation and approval entries.
evidence_items.learned: The relevant resource source is in current build scope and should be judged as part of the current specification.

evidence_items.summary: Current source defines SpecimenDefinition with canonical URL http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/SpecimenDefinition, resource kind, concrete type, and description as a kind of specimen with requirements.
evidence_items.learned: The current spec contains the resource type requested by FHIR-10529.

evidence_items.summary: ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement is a 0..* canonical element targetting SpecimenDefinition and describing required specimens for lab tests.
evidence_items.learned: The current source contains the ActivityDefinition use point required by the FHIR-10529/FHIR-10528 issue family.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-10528 applied the ActivityDefinition specimenRequirement side at SVN 12592 and is already audited on the combined branch.
evidence_items.learned: The paired ActivityDefinition issue should not receive another commit from this seed, but it confirms the dependency was fulfilled.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue changed ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement, observationRequirement, and observationResultRequirement to canonical.
evidence_items.learned: The current canonical datatype is an approved later change and should not be treated as a missed Reference(SpecimenDefinition) implementation detail.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive issue where the submitter withdrew a request to make ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement a backbone element.
evidence_items.learned: No later final decision requires changing the current simple repeated ActivityDefinition.specimenRequirement element.

evidence_items.summary: Later R6 issue proposes SpecimenDefinition relationship prose changes including ActivityDefinition/PlanDefinition/RequestOrchestration bullets and Catalog-resource cleanup, but its workflow status is Triaged.
evidence_items.learned: Draft resolution text on a Triaged issue is not final enough to edit current source during this Applied/Published seed reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: The 2020 thread discusses lab compendium modeling and states ActivityDefinition supports SpecimenDefinition via specimenRequirement while the order-catalog IG evolved away from CatalogEntry toward PlanDefinition plus definitional resources.
evidence_items.learned: Community context does not contradict the current SpecimenDefinition/ActivityDefinition source and reinforces that Catalog narrative cleanup is a separate later concern.
